buildings.name: Main Academic & Technology Block
buildings.description: Primary academic building housing Engineering departments (CSE, ECE, EE, IT, ECS), Dean & HOD offices, state-of-the-art computer centers, and central lecture theatres.

buildings.name: Management & Computer Applications Block
buildings.description: Houses Department of Business Administration (MBA, BBA), Department of Computer Applications (MCA, BCA), Management Development Centre and Executive Classrooms.

buildings.name: Engineering Workshops & Civil/Mechanical Complex
buildings.description: Houses heavy engineering equipment, Machine Shop, Foundry & Welding Shop, Strength of Materials Lab, Surveying Lab, and Civil Concrete Technology Lab.

buildings.name: First Year Block (Basic Science & Humanities)
buildings.description: Dedicated academic block for first-year engineering students, housing Engineering Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Professional Communication Labs, and Orientation Classrooms.

buildings.name: Central Library & Administrative Block
buildings.description: Main administrative nerve center housing Director & Principal Offices, Registrar, Student Affairs, Accounts Section, and the multi-story Central Digital Library with over 50,000 volumes.

buildings.name: Administrative Annex & Student Services
buildings.description: Student Affairs, Scholarship Cell, Anti-Ragging Committee, Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC), and Alumni Association Office.

buildings.name: Central Canteen & Cafeteria (Tutul's Food)
buildings.description: Vibrant campus social hub offering healthy North & South Indian meals, snacks, tea, coffee, fresh juice, and student gathering spaces.

buildings.name: Cafeteria Outdoor Pavilion A
buildings.description: Open-air shaded pavilion adjoining the central cafeteria with seating under garden canopies.

buildings.name: Cafeteria Outdoor Pavilion B
buildings.description: Open-air beverage stall and seating pavilion.

buildings.name: Indoor Sports & Gym Building
buildings.description: Two-story Indoor Sports Complex and Gymnasium facility featuring indoor courts, fitness center, and student recreation halls.

buildings.name: Swami Vivekananda Boys' Hostel (Block A)
buildings.description: On-campus residential accommodation for male engineering and management students, with Wi-Fi, dining hall, gym room and 24/7 security.

buildings.name: Swami Vivekananda Boys' Hostel (Block B)
buildings.description: Senior student residential wing with study halls, indoor games room, and solar water heating.

buildings.name: Sister Nivedita Girls' Hostel (Block A)
buildings.description: Secure, monitored residential hostel for female students with attached mess, study lounges, recreational room and round-the-clock matron supervision.

buildings.name: Sister Nivedita Girls' Hostel (Block B)
buildings.description: Second wing of Sister Nivedita residential accommodation for female students.

buildings.name: Campus Electrical Substation & Power House
buildings.description: Dedicated transformer station, heavy backup diesel generators (DG Sets), and electrical distribution panel for 24x7 uninterrupted campus power.

buildings.name: Campus Estate & Facility Maintenance Office
buildings.description: Civil, plumbing, electrical maintenance workshops and campus security dispatch.

buildings.name: Main Entrance Gate & Security Checkpoint
buildings.description: Primary campus entrance on Hill Cart Road with vehicle boom barriers, 24/7 security personnel, visitor pass counter and CCTV surveillance hub.

buildings.name: Visitors Reception & Waiting Lounge
buildings.description: Comfortable waiting lounge for visiting parents, guests, and campus delivery personnel.

buildings.name: Academic Block Grand Portico
buildings.description: Architectural covered drop-off porch and ceremonial entrance arch for the Main Academic Block.

buildings.name: Campus Basketball Court
buildings.description: Regulation FIBA outdoor basketball court with grey acrylic surface, orange goal-post keys & center circle, white markings, dual hoops, night floodlights, and adjacent sitting bench area.

buildings.name: Central Landscaped Garden & Lawn
buildings.description: Manicured central campus lawn in front of the Main Academic Building featuring sculpted SIT topiary grass lettering, boxwood hedges, burgundy shrubs, and flowering borders.

buildings.name: Basketball Sitting Bench Area
buildings.description: Roadside paved seating plaza with 5 campus park benches and shrub borders overlooking the basketball court.

buildings.name: Campus Volleyball Court
buildings.description: Simple outdoor campus volleyball court located between Boys Hostel Block B and Admin & Library.

tourStops.title: Main Entrance & Security Gate
tourStops.description: Welcome to Siliguri Institute of Technology! The main campus gate sits on Hill Cart Road in Salbari, surrounded by the Chamtaguri Tea Gardens.

tourStops.title: Central Reception & Administration Block
tourStops.description: The administrative heart of SIT housing the Principal and Director offices, Registrar, Student Affairs, and Accounts.

tourStops.title: Central Digital Library
tourStops.description: Houses over 50,000 engineering, management, and scientific volumes along with IEEE/Springer digital access and quiet reading halls.

tourStops.title: Main Academic & Technology Complex
tourStops.description: The flagship 4-story complex with its iconic dome, housing CSE, ECE, EE, IT, and ECS departments, smart classrooms, and computing labs.

tourStops.title: Central Landscaped Garden
tourStops.description: The signature SIT landscaped lawn in front of the Main Academic Complex featuring trimmed SIT topiary grass lettering and ornamental shrubs.

tourStops.title: First Year Induction Block
tourStops.description: The starting point for every fresher—featuring dedicated classrooms, Engineering Physics & Chemistry labs, and the First-Year office.

tourStops.title: Central Canteen & Indoor Sports
tourStops.description: The hub of campus student life featuring Tutul's Food Canteen, outdoor pavilions, and the 2-story Indoor Sports & Gym Building.

tourStops.title: Campus Hostels & Residential Enclave
tourStops.description: Safe residential hostels for boys (Swami Vivekananda) and girls (Sister Nivedita) with mess halls, Wi-Fi, and 24/7 security.

tourStops.title: SIT Main Sports Ground
tourStops.description: Full-size football ground with goal posts and cricket pitch hosting annual sports meets, inter-college tournaments, and campus fests.
